- [FACT] User inquired about the value of negatively geared versus positively geared property in Australia.
- [ASSISTANT] Assistant explained negatively geared properties have rental income less than expenses, while positively geared properties have rental income exceeding expenses.
- [ASSISTANT] Assistant noted that positively geared properties are generally considered more valuable in Australia due to providing a steady income stream and being less risky.
- [ASSISTANT] Assistant mentioned that some investors prefer negatively geared properties for tax deductions and potential long-term capital growth.

- [ASSISTANT] Assistant indicated that 12 games were played at Arrowhead Stadium, with the Chiefs winning 10 and the Jaguars winning 2.
